title: Enumerate Partitions of Grid Graphs
text: enum enumerates partitions graph k connected pieces within given piece-size bounds. reimplementation Julia enumerator package Zachary Schutzman, core algorithms written C support igraph objects input.

title: Enumerate Partitions of Grid Graphs
text: primary interface partitions rectangular grids rook queen contiguity. column returned matrix one valid partition; row corresponds grid cell row-major order, integer values giving part membership. example, one valid partition 3×3 grid stored column c(1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3). can also count number, faster don’t need full output:

title: Count grid partitions — enum_count_partitions
text: Count number valid partitions nrow ncol grid num_parts connected pieces, piece min_size max_size cells. Prefer enum_partitions() count needed, avoids storing partitions memory.

code: enum_count_partitions(   nrow,   ncol,   num_parts,   min_size,   max_size,   contiguity = c("rook", "queen") )

title: Count grid partitions — enum_count_partitions
text: nrow Integer. Number rows grid. ncol Integer. Number columns grid. num_parts Integer. Number parts partition grid . min_size Integer. Minimum number cells per part. max_size Integer. Maximum number cells per part. contiguity Character. Either "rook" (default) edge-adjacency "queen" edge--corner adjacency.

title: Count grid partitions — enum_count_partitions
text: single integer giving number valid partitions.

title: Count grid partitions — enum_count_partitions

title: Enumerate grid partitions — enum_partitions
text: Enumerate partitions nrow ncol grid num_parts connected pieces, piece min_size max_size cells.

title: Enumerate grid partitions — enum_partitions
code: enum_partitions(   nrow,   ncol,   num_parts,   min_size,   max_size,   contiguity = c("rook", "queen"),   file = NULL )

title: Enumerate grid partitions — enum_partitions
text: nrow Integer. Number rows grid. ncol Integer. Number columns grid. num_parts Integer. Number parts partition grid . min_size Integer. Minimum number cells per part. max_size Integer. Maximum number cells per part. contiguity Character. Either "rook" (default) edge-adjacency "queen" edge--corner adjacency. file Character NULL. file path provided, partitions written binary file instead returned matrix. partition stored nrow * ncol consecutive 32-bit integers. Use enum_read_partitions() read file back R. file NULL, function returns partition count invisibly.

title: Enumerate grid partitions — enum_partitions
text: file NULL (default), integer matrix column partition row corresponds cell grid row-major order. Cell values integers 1 num_parts indicating part membership. file path, returns number partitions written, invisibly.

title: Enumerate grid partitions — enum_partitions
code: # Partition a 2x3 grid into 2 rook-connected parts of size 3 enum_partitions(2, 3, num_parts = 2, min_size = 3, max_size = 3) #>      [,1] [,2] [,3] #> [1,]    1    1    1 #> [2,]    1    1    2 #> [3,]    2    1    2 #> [4,]    1    2    1 #> [5,]    2    2    1 #> [6,]    2    2    2

enum 0.0.1
text: core enumeration algorithms rewritten C, yielding large speed improvements grid graph partition functions. enum_partitions() enum_partitions_graph() gain file argument. provided, partitions streamed binary file instead returned matrix, enabling enumeration large cases otherwise exhaust memory. New enum_read_partitions() reads binary file written enum_partitions() enum_partitions_graph(). skip n arguments allow reading arbitrary subsets without loading full file memory.
